info.title: Rodokmen API
info.description: Read API of the Rodokmen Tree, Proposals and review, history, images, member accounts, Agents and sign-in. Every route except the health check and the sign-in steps needs a signed-in Member (session cookie) or an Agent token (Authorization: Bearer rdk_ag_…). Agents may only read and submit Proposals, within hourly limits (429 with retryAt beyond them).
